# Zoe Talent Solutions

> Global training and consulting firm delivering professional development, corporate training, and social development programs across Dubai, Middle East, Africa, and Asia with KHDA, PMI, and HRCI accreditations.

Zoe Talent Solutions is a KHDA-accredited training provider specializing in customized corporate training, e-learning solutions, and development support programs. The organization combines professional certifications (SAP, Microsoft, CIPS, PMI) with social welfare initiatives including women empowerment, youth advocacy, and life skills training in partnership with international NGOs.

## Key Topics

## Core Services & Solutions

- [Customized In House Training](https://zoetalentsolutions.com/solutions/customized-in-house-training): Customized in-house training with training needs assessment and ROI measurement
- [E-Learning](https://zoetalentsolutions.com/solutions/e-learning): Virtual classroom e-learning programs with competency assessment and knowledge management
- [Solutions](https://zoetalentsolutions.com/solutions): Organizational solutions including talent development, coaching, and change management

## Course Offerings & Registration

- [Find Courses](https://zoetalentsolutions.com/all-courses): Course directory and search portal across Dubai, Riyadh, Jeddah, Cairo, Houston
- [Search Live Training Schedules](https://zoetalentsolutions.com/online-training-schedules): Live online training schedules and course registration for professional development

## Development Support Programs

- [Development Support Training Program](https://zoetalentsolutions.com/development-support): Development support programs for capacity building with ATA and Afghan Trust Association
- [Women Empowerment](https://zoetalentsolutions.com/development-support/women-empowerment): Women empowerment initiatives in Africa, India, and Middle East with partner NGOs
- [Youth Advocacy Development Support Training Course](https://zoetalentsolutions.com/development-support/youth-advocacy-development-support-training-course): Youth advocacy training with International Justice Mission for human rights empowerment
- [Life Skills Development Support Program](https://zoetalentsolutions.com/development-support/life-skills): Life skills training aligned with WHO standards for stress management and communication
- [Educational Support](https://zoetalentsolutions.com/development-support/educational-support): Corporate executive courses with SAP, Microsoft, CIPS, and IHRME certifications
- [Domestic Counselling Development Support](https://zoetalentsolutions.com/development-support/domestic-counselling): Domestic counselling and victim support services using cognitive behavioural therapy
